copy: Copy v4 is the only source of text. The live pages follow it; where a page and Copy v4 differ, Copy v4 wins.

index-v2.title: Bridgify | The Infrastructure Behind Travel Experiences
index-v2.description: Bridgify, part of HBX Group, is the world's leading B2B travel experiences infrastructure: 1M+ tours, attractions and activities, matched to every customer.

api.title: Travel APIs for Tours, Attractions & Activities | Bridgify
api.description: The largest experiences catalog through one integration: 1M+ tours, attractions, activities and events, multi-source supply and real-time availability.

marketplace.title: White-Label Travel Marketplace for Experiences | Bridgify
marketplace.description: Your branded marketplace for tours, attractions, activities and events. 1M+ experiences, search, checkout and payments. No developers needed. Live in 3 days.

personalization.title: AIyelet: AI Tour & Experience Recommendations | Bridgify
personalization.description: AIyelet recommends the right tours, attractions and activities to each traveler, using intent and context, inside your own product. By Bridgify.

developers.title: Developers | Bridgify Experiences API Documentation
developers.description: Documentation for the Bridgify Experiences API: getting started, API reference and integration support for tours, attractions and activities.

otas.title: Tours & Activities for OTAs | B2B Travel Platform | Bridgify
otas.description: Add 1M+ tours, attractions and events to your OTA through one integration: multi-source supply, real-time availability, your brand.

airlines.title: Destination Experiences for Airlines | Bridgify
airlines.description: Offer destination experiences under your airline’s brand. One connected layer for 1M+ tours, attractions, activities and events across your passenger journey.

hotels.title: Experiences API for Hotels: Tours & Activities | Bridgify
hotels.description: Add 1M+ tours, attractions and activities to your guest journey, digital concierge or PMS through one experiences API or a branded marketplace.

loyalty-finance.title: Travel Rewards & Experiences for Loyalty Programs | Bridgify
loyalty-finance.description: Give members 1M+ tours, attractions and events to redeem points on, under your brand. A travel rewards marketplace or API, with payments built in.

travel-technology.title: Add Experiences to B2B Travel Agency Software | Bridgify
travel-technology.description: Embed 1M+ tours, attractions and events in your travel software, agency platform or tour-operator system through one API.

super-apps.title: Travel Booking API for Super Apps & Fintechs | Bridgify
super-apps.description: Add 1M+ bookable tours, attractions and events to your super app, wallet or mobility app through one travel booking API or a branded marketplace.

about-us.title: About Bridgify | B2B Traveltech Company, Part of HBX Group
about-us.description: Bridgify is the world's leading B2B travel experiences infrastructure, bringing 1M+ tours and attractions to the brands people use. Part of HBX Group.

careers.title: Careers at Bridgify | Build the Future of Travel Experiences
careers.description: Join the team building the infrastructure behind travel experiences, used by banks, airlines and super apps. Open roles at Bridgify, part of HBX Group.

contact.title: Book a Demo | Bridgify Experiences API and White-Label
contact.description: Talk to Bridgify about adding 1M+ tours, attractions and experiences to your product through the Experiences API, White-Label Marketplace or AIyelet.

press.title: Bridgify in the Press | News and Announcements
press.description: Coverage, interviews and announcements about Bridgify, part of HBX Group, and the business of travel experiences.

insights.title: Travel Experiences Insights | Bridgify
insights.description: Insights on experience supply, API integration, white-label marketplaces, personalization and loyalty from the Bridgify team, part of HBX Group.

analytics.today: Only the homepage loads Google tag (gtag) and Segment; no other page loads analytics.

accessibility: WCAG 2.2 AA: contrast (see Color), visible keyboard focus, 44px tap targets on phones, every control reachable by keyboard.
prefers-reduced-motion: every animation stops or shows its last frame.
One h1 per page; headings in order; FAQ answers readable without JavaScript.
performance: Largest Contentful Paint under 2.5s on a mid-range phone over 4G.
Cumulative Layout Shift under 0.1 (no jump on load).
Animations run on transform and opacity; heavy demos start only when in view.

open_questions.question: Where should the Contact and Book a demo forms send (CRM, e-mail address, or an API)? Today no submit address is set.
Which system does Log in connect to? The form has no endpoint today.
Which analytics and events should every page load? Today only the homepage loads gtag and Segment.
No page has Open Graph tags (the preview when a link is shared). Supply a share image and text per page, or one default.
Canonicals point to www.bridgify.io; confirm the production domain and the redirect from the old site.
Confirm the Chillax licence covers web use on bridgify.io.
Which framework will the developers use? It decides the tokens format and how the animations are handed over.
